title: Delivering high-performance customer support
summary: Decagon and OpenAI deliver high-performance, fully automated customer support at scale
body: Decagon and OpenAI deliver high-performance, fully automated customer support at scale
summaryZh: Decagon与OpenAI展开合作，利用大语言模型提供大规模、高性能且完全自动化的客户支持方案，展现了企业客服领域向深度AI生成式自动化转型的落地成果。原始信息显示：Decagon and OpenAI deliver high-performance, fully automated customer support at scale。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Delivering high-performance customer support”。其重要性主要体现在：Decagon联合OpenAI推出了大规模的高性能全自动化客户支持解决方案。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
